CustomField.description: The PII type assigned to this field, matching the PII Field Type value of an AI PII Field Type custom metadata record (for example Email, SSN or a type added by the subscriber).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically during sync based on the field's name, label, data type, and Compliance Group. Blank means the field isn't recognized as a specific PII type.
CustomField.label: PII Field Type
